_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joolz Day3

clekListed.clekRow: Joolz Day3 — Day3 Car Seat Adapter – Nuna, Cybex, Maxi-Cosi, Clek (511000)

specs._weightNote: Frame + seat 12.9 kg / 28.4 lb (Joolz/Strollberry). Some US retailer listings state ~29.1 lb.
specs._dimsNote: Folds with seat attached in one motion; folded (frame only) ~27 x 23 x 13 in.

brake.type: foot-operated push-down / lift-up central pedal brake

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth (includes full carrycot/bassinet, birth to ~20 lb); seat mode 6 mo+

safety.standards: EN 1888 (Joolz). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat (parent- or world-facing); full-recline backrest; 10-year transferable warranty.

specs.foldType: one-motion compact fold (seat can stay attached), self-standing
specs.tires: 7 in front / 12 in rear EVA foam-coated wheels; all-wheel suspension

notes: Full-size convertible pram (heavier, ~28 lb) — more of a do-everything city pram than the ultralight goal, but on Clek's list. Ships with bassinet; MSRP ~$999. Liing attaches via the Joolz Day2/Day3 adapter (adapter-511000), the ONE adapter in this batch whose name explicitly enumerates Clek. Seat max child weight: Joolz EU rates 15 kg (33 lb); US retailer listings state up to 50 lb — recorded 50 with the discrepancy noted.
